[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Marshall''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a member of the [[Eighty-first Infantry]]. He was stationed with his men above [[Voss]], where they saw no action whatsoever. After the [[Havoc Squad]] [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Commander]] convinced [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]] to re-deploy 81st elsewhere, Marshall and his men were extremely grateful. They soon returned their favor by helping the [[Major/Legends|Major]] apprehend [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
